title: Peoplesoft Payroll Functional Lead/Product Manager
description:
1 00% remote - work will be in 9-5 PST hours...prefer west coast based consutlants.
Seeking a Payroll Product Manager to support strategy, planning, and execution for Payroll and Absence Management within a large HR/Payroll shared services organization in Higher Ed.

The Product Manager will drive initiatives from requirements definition through delivery, ensuring alignment with business policies, compliance standards, and operational needs across the institution.
This role requires a senior product leader who can quickly assess the current environment, collaborate with stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Scope of Work / Responsibilities
  • Own and define the product vision and strategy for Payroll and Absence Management, ensuring alignment with organization's mission, compliance obligations, and evolving business/user needs.
  • Lead Roadmap definition and execution for Payroll and Absence Management.
  • Partner with operations teams, IT, Business leaders, and other business units to define and prioritize initiatives.
  • Gather, document, and validate business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Oversee development, testing, and deployment of product features and enhancements in collaboration with IT and business teams.
  • Lead change management efforts, including stakeholder communications, training coordination, and adoption support.
  • Ensure solutions comply with institution policies, regulatory requirements, and union agreements.
  • Develop clear documentation, recommendations, and transition materials to support long-term product sustainability.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership on progress, risks, and outcomes.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 7+ years of product management experience (Payroll, HR, or Benefits systems).
  • Strongly preferred – Expert functional and business knowledge of PeopleSoft HCM , Payroll and Absence management modules.
  • Business Analyst and Project manager experience would be a plus.
  • Proven success leading payroll or HR technology initiatives in large, complex, or shared-services environments.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience balancing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills; ability to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills; able to evaluate trade-offs and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Familiarity with product development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of payroll regulations, workforce administration, and union agreements.
  • Prior consulting, contract, or interim leadership experience.

title: Data Analyst / Power BI resource
description:
Anticipated Project Start Date: 9/29/2025
Anticipated End Date: 6/30/2026
Client seeks a Power BI Data Analyst to design and build real-time and near real-time dashboards that complete Client's situational awareness capability. This contractor will transform curated Delta Lake data—queried via Azure Synapse serverless SQL pools or Azure SQL—into compelling, actionable visuals hosted in the Power BI GCC (Government Cloud) environment. The analyst must pair advanced SQL and DAX skills with solid dashboard design expertise, operate within GCC constraints (no Microsoft Fabric), and collaborate closely with the Operations team to turn requirements into user-focused reports.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • 3+ years building enterprise dashboards with Power BI (Desktop & Service)
  • Expert-level DAX and Power Query (M); deep experience optimizing models for performance
  • Advanced T-SQL skills for query design, tuning, and data validation
  • Demonstrated success delivering real-time or streaming Power BI solutions (DirectQuery, push datasets, or Stream Analytics output)
  • Familiarity with Azure Synapse serverless SQL pools, Delta Lake tables, and Azure SQL
  • Strong data visualization and UI/UX instincts; ability to translate operational scenarios into clear visuals
  • Experience operating in Microsoft GCC or other government/regulated cloud a strong plus
  • Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) or Azure Enterprise Data Analyst (DP-500)
  • Exposure to geospatial visuals or ArcGIS for Power BI
  • Understanding of metadata-driven data lakehouse architectures and medallion patterns

title: Oracle Cloud Report Developer
description:
USC or GC
100% remote
3 month contract with possible extensions
Public sector / higher ed experience needed

The Oracle Cloud Report Developer is responsible for Oracle Cloud reporting tools such as OTBI (Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence), BI Publisher, and Fusion Data Intelligence (formerly Fusion Analytics Warehouse). This role will be instrumental in designing and developing scalable, secure, and user-friendly reporting solutions to support enterprise decision-making. The position requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to transform business needs into actionable insights.

Duties:
  • Design, develop, and maintain reports and dashboards using OTBI, BI Publisher, and Fusion Data Intelligence.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and translate reporting requirements into technical specifications.
  • Build custom data models, subject areas, and data visualizations to support self-service analytics.
  • Optimize report performance and troubleshoot issues related to data accuracy and system integration.
  • Assist in data validation, quality assurance, and system testing for new releases and patches.
  • Provide end-user training and documentation for reports, dashboards, and self-service tools.
  • Partner with functional teams to ensure data alignment with business processes.
  • Support data governance initiatives and promote best practices for secure, compliant reporting.
  • Contribute to integration efforts with other reporting tools or data platforms as needed.

Education/Experience Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS or other field involving software and analytical training, and four years of IT related work experience, OR a Bachelor's degree with no specific required field and five years of IT related work experience, OR a Master's degree and three years of IT related work experience, OR a combination of eight years of IT related work experience and validated training. Preparation for a relevant IT certification is considered to be related training.

- Hands-on experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, and Fusion Data Intelligence/Fusion Analytics Warehouse.
- Proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and understanding of relational data models.
- Familiarity with Oracle Cloud subject areas and metadata layers.
- Understanding of data security models and role-based access in Oracle Cloud.
- Experience with Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) / Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) implementation and customization.
- Familiarity with REST APIs, OData connectors, or other integration techniques.
- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI) for cross-platform reporting.
- Understanding of Oracle Cloud architecture and update cycles.
- Oracle Cloud certification(s) in reporting, analytics, or related areas.

title: Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) Developer
description:
US Citizens / Green Card Holder
6 month contract
100% remote
Must have strong communication skills
Start date - 6th October


Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) Developer to join our team on a contract basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying applications using Oracle VBCS, integrating with Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications and REST/SOAP APIs. This role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate with functional consultants, architects, and business stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain applications and extensions using Oracle VBCS.
  • Build responsive web and mobile user interfaces leveraging Oracle JET and VBCS components.
  • Develop integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud).
  • Customize and extend Oracle SaaS applications to meet business requirements.
  • Work closely with solution architects and functional leads to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Conduct unit testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of VBCS applications.
  • Support deployment, configuration, and post-go-live activities.
  • Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to internal teams.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 5+ years of IT experience with at least 2+ years in Oracle VBCS development.
  • Strong experience with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Oracle JET.
  • Hands-on experience integrating VBCS with Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications (ERP, SCM, HCM, etc.).
  • Proficiency in working with REST and SOAP APIs for application integrations.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), ADF, or PCS is a plus.
  • Experience in Agile development methodology and DevOps practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with distributed teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Oracle VBCS or OIC certification.
  • Experience with Oracle SaaS extensions (ERP, SCM, HCM).
  • Exposure to cloud deployment models and CI/CD pipelines.
